//! T-2013: writes an alpha.13 ledger with the state D8's update must carry. Run once by hand:
//! T2013_OUT=/path/file.db cargo test -p cf-ledger --test t2013_fixture -- --ignored

#![allow(clippy::expect_used, clippy::unwrap_used)]

use cf_ledger::{
    open_ledger, Ledger, NewChief, NewMember, NewProject, NewQuestion, NewTask, Options,
};
use serde_json::json;

fn options() -> Options {
    let mut names = [
        "amber", "birch", "cedar", "dune", "elm", "fern", "glen", "heath", "iris", "jade",
        "kelp", "lark", "moss", "nook", "oak", "pine",
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .cycle();
    Options {
        names: Box::new(move || names.next().unwrap_or_default().to_owned()),
        ..Options::default()
    }
}

fn member(name: &str, roles: &[&str], tier: &str) -> NewMember {
    NewMember {
        model: None,
        effort: None,
        model_name: Some(name.into()),
        harness: "claude-code".into(),
        designer: false,
        roles: roles.iter().map(|r| (*r).to_owned()).collect(),
        tier: tier.into(),
    }
}

fn project(ledger: &mut Ledger, dir: &str, gate: bool, staff: Vec<NewMember>) -> i64 {
    ledger
        .create_project(&NewProject {
            directory: dir.into(),
            name: dir.trim_start_matches("/work/").into(),
            chief: NewChief {
                harness: "claude-code".into(),
                model: Some("apollo".into()),
                effort: None,
                model_name: None,
            },
            staff,
            gate,
            wake_up: None,
            specs: None,
            staff_rules: None,
            compaction: None,
            advisor_tool: false,
            prompt_suggestion: false,
            own_hands: false,
        })
        .expect("a project")
        .id
}

fn id(ledger: &Ledger, project: i64, handle: &str) -> i64 {
    ledger
        .project(project)
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap()
        .participants
        .into_iter()
        .find(|p| p.handle == handle)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no @{handle}"))
        .id
}

fn task(ledger: &mut Ledger, project: i64, pool: &str, tier: Option<&str>, purpose: Option<&str>, body: &str) -> i64 {
    ledger
        .create_task(
            project,
            &NewTask {
                from: "chief".into(),
                pool: Some(pool.into()),
                tier: tier.map(str::to_owned),
                purpose: purpose.map(str::to_owned),
                body: body.into(),
                ..NewTask::default()
            },
        )
        .expect("a task")
        .task
        .number
}

/// Assign T-`number` to `member`; return its brief's id.
fn assign(ledger: &mut Ledger, project: i64, number: i64, member: &str) -> i64 {
    let member = id(ledger, project, member);
    ledger
        .assign_task(project, number, member)
        .expect("assigned")
        .message
        .expect("its brief")
        .id
}

fn deliver(ledger: &mut Ledger, brief: i64) {
    ledger.begin_delivery(brief).expect("begins");
    ledger
        .confirm_delivery(brief, Some(&json!({ "item": "i-1" })))
        .expect("delivered");
}

fn window_of(ledger: &Ledger, project: i64, number: i64) -> String {
    ledger.task(project, number).unwrap().unwrap().task.assignee.expect("a window")
}

#[test]
#[ignore = "writes the T-2013 fixture"]
fn write_the_alpha_13_fixture() {
    let out = std::env::var("T2013_OUT").expect("T2013_OUT");
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&out);
    let mut ledger = open_ledger(std::path::Path::new(&out), options()).expect("a ledger");
    // Project 1: a frontend designer (no tier in alpha.13) with a current backup, and a
    // Critical worker.
    let board = project(
        &mut ledger,
        "/work/board",
        false,
        vec![member("iris", &["frontend"], "light"), member("zeus", &["worker"], "critical")],
    );
    ledger
        .add_backup(board, "iris", &member("irene", &["frontend"], "light"))
        .expect("a backup");
    // T-1: in the backup's window, delivered; the window asks the chief, unanswered.
    let t1 = task(&mut ledger, board, "frontend", None, None, "Draw the page");
    let brief = assign(&mut ledger, board, t1, "irene");
    deliver(&mut ledger, brief);
    let window = window_of(&ledger, board, t1);
    ledger
        .ask(
            board,
            &NewQuestion {
                from: Some(window.clone()),
                to: "chief".into(),
                body: Some("Which format?".into()),
                task: Some(t1),
                ..NewQuestion::default()
            },
        )
        .expect("the window asks");
    // T-2: a follow-up of T-1, bound to its window, waiting for T-1's acceptance.
    ledger
        .create_task(
            board,
            &NewTask {
                from: "chief".into(),
                after: Some(t1),
                body: "Follow up".into(),
                ..NewTask::default()
            },
        )
        .expect("the follow-up");
    // T-3 in the member's window and T-4 in the backup's: done, accepted, the windows ended by
    // the human: closed windows.
    for (number_body, holder) in [("Old page", "iris"), ("Old form", "irene")] {
        let number = task(&mut ledger, board, "frontend", None, None, number_body);
        let brief = assign(&mut ledger, board, number, holder);
        deliver(&mut ledger, brief);
        ledger.record_result(board, number, "Done").expect("result");
        ledger.accept_task(board, number, "chief").expect("accepted");
        let window = window_of(&ledger, board, number);
        ledger.end_session(board, &window, "human").expect("ended");
    }
    // T-5: Critical work for the worker, delivered: history.
    let t5 = task(&mut ledger, board, "worker", Some("critical"), Some("hard-problem"), "Old work");
    let brief = assign(&mut ledger, board, t5, "zeus");
    deliver(&mut ledger, brief);
    // T-6: Critical work for the worker, its brief queued for the window.
    let t6 = task(&mut ledger, board, "worker", Some("critical"), Some("hard-problem"), "Modify a project file");
    assign(&mut ledger, board, t6, "zeus");
    // T-7: Critical work for the worker, open on the board.
    task(&mut ledger, board, "worker", Some("critical"), Some("hard-problem"), "Modify another file");
    // T-8: Critical work for a reviewer, open: its line says it changes no file, as before.
    let gated = project(
        &mut ledger,
        "/work/gated",
        true,
        vec![member("ares", &["worker"], "critical"), member("hera", &["reviewer"], "critical")],
    );
    // The gated project: Critical work for the worker and for the reviewer, briefs gated.
    let g1 = task(&mut ledger, gated, "worker", Some("critical"), Some("hard-problem"), "Modify a project file");
    assign(&mut ledger, gated, g1, "ares");
    let g2 = task(&mut ledger, gated, "reviewer", Some("critical"), Some("critical-review"), "Review it");
    assign(&mut ledger, gated, g2, "hera");
    ledger.close_in_place().expect("closed");
}

#[test]
#[ignore = "answers the fixture's question on alpha.13"]
fn answer_on_alpha_13() {
    let out = std::env::var("T2013_COPY").expect("T2013_COPY");
    let mut ledger = open_ledger(std::path::Path::new(&out), Options::default()).expect("a ledger");
    ledger.begin_delivery(2).expect("begins");
    ledger.confirm_delivery(2, Some(&json!({ "item": "i-q" }))).expect("delivered");
    let said = ledger.answer(2, 2, Some(&json!("JSON")), None);
    println!("ANSWER: {said:?}");
}
